answer: A meadow stays healthy only when every grazer pays for the grass it eats. An agent economy can work the same way: before an identity may trade, it must fund a public good, such as curating an open benchmark or running a relay, with the contribution recorded on-ledger and checked by peers. Each violet badge of standing is earned this way, not bought. A Sybil running a hundred puppets must fund a hundred real contributions, while one honest agent pays once; the network pulse is measured in useful work, and the cost of faking an army grows with every fake mouth to feed.
